summary: The fund will normally invest at least 80% of assets in common stocks included in the MSCI EAFE Index, which is a market capitalization-weighted index that is designed to measure the investable equity market performance for global investors in developed markets, excluding the U.S. & Canada. The adviser will generally utilizing a research-driven approach identifying long-term drivers of stock returns that may include, but are not limited to, valuation, growth, quality, and other factors.
